description: Every price TF Handy Wash publishes, quoted from its prices page: washer price per wash cycle by size, the dryer price and minutes per cycle, the cost-per-load table with the site's own home-load comparison, and the FAQ answers on wash cost, dryer cost and what to bring. Prices are returned exactly as published (strings such as "$2.75"); nothing is added up here.
name: get_pricing
